title: Find the mistake: statements
instructions: Each sentence has **one** mistake – or no mistake at all. Find the wrong word and write the correct sentence.

items.sentence: Sofia said me that she was tired.
answer: Sofia told me (that) she was tired.
Sofia said to me (that) she was tired.

items.sentence: Diego said that he is going to the cinema the next day.
items.answer: Diego said (that) he was going to the cinema the next day.

items.sentence: Mila told that she had lost her key.
answer: Mila said (that) she had lost her key.
Mila told [me|us|him|her|them] (that) she had lost her key.

items.sentence: Tyler said that he had seen the film two days before.
items.hint: Check the tense and the time expression.

items.sentence: Aisha told Mila that she will call her later.
items.answer: Aisha told Mila (that) she would call her later.

items.sentence: Mr Okafor told me that I must change my timetable.
items.answer: Mr Okafor told me (that) I had to change my timetable.

items.sentence: Mila said that her parents have visited New York.
items.answer: Mila said (that) her parents had visited New York.

items.sentence: Diego told us that he had finished his homework yesterday.
items.answer: Diego told us (that) he had finished his homework [the day before|the previous day].
